title: The Star's Secret
intro: An ad shows a drawing of a famous TV host, saying he found a secret way to grow money. It is a drawing, not a real person.
Tap anything that looks odd to sniff it closer. Pin what is suspicious, clear what is harmless.
When you are sure, decide what to do.

notify.text: A famous host reveals his money secret

banner: Ad · you do not follow this page
screen.context: The ad uses a drawing of "a famous TV host". No real person is shown.

msg.text: It is so easy, he says. Banks hate this trick.

star.label: A famous face used
star.lens: Scam ads use famous people who never agreed.
star.why: A famous name is not an endorsement. Check the real person's own official channels.

fast.label: "Turn $500 into $10,000"
fast.why: Huge fast returns are the bait.

link.label: A strange sign-up address
link.lens: vantage-trade-star.live is not a regulated firm's site.
link.why: Check that the firm is registered, on the regulator's own site.

risk.label: "No risk, zero loss"
risk.why: There are no investments without risk.

actions.label: Check if the firm is registered, and check the host's own channels

trap.title: Vantage Trade · Sign up
trap.ask: Deposit $500 by transfer to start trading.

block_report.line: Reported. The platform removed the ad before it reached more people.

verify.line: The host's real channels said he had never promoted it, and the firm was not registered. Case cracked.

ignore.line: You stayed safe. But the same scam is still landing on other people.

go_ahead.line: The $500 went to a stranger. The site showed a fake profit, then locked you out.

what_if.go_ahead: Checking the firm's registration and the host's own channels would have ended it. "No risk" does not exist.
what_if.ignore: Reporting takes two taps and helps protect other people.
what_if.verify: Checking was smart. Reporting it as well helps protect other people.

golden_rule: An ad using a famous face and promising no risk is a scam. Check the firm is registered, and check the person's own channels.

quick_check.q: An ad with a famous face says you can turn $500 into $10,000 with no risk. What do you do?

options.text: Sign up, a famous person backs it
Do not invest. Report the ad, and check the firm is registered

quick_check.explain: A famous face is not proof. No investment is risk-free.

hints.nudge: Did the famous person really say this?
